notes:
Say how much, and Crisp listens.

"Make it a bit faster" and "make it way faster" used to do exactly the same thing — two times speed, either way. Same for a bit louder, a bit sharper, slightly more saturated: every strength of the ask got the strongest answer. Crisp now reads the words, across speed, volume, sharpening and colour, as it already did for brightness. Asking for it plainly still does what it always did.
